name: demucs-stem
description: Splits a song into four stems (vocals, drums, bass, other) with Demucs, as a zip of MP3s
notes: A batch tool: one task per song, `demucs-stem {in:file} {out:result}` with out_ext .zip. Uses the GPU (MPS).
usage: demucs-stem {in:file} {out:result}  (result: a .zip of vocals, drums, bass and other MP3s)

install.summary: Demucs stem separation: Python packages and the htdemucs model, about 1 GB

files.demucs-stem:
#!/bin/bash
# Installed by macmesh: splits a song into vocals, drums, bass and other (Demucs htdemucs).
set -euo pipefail
if [ "${1:-}" = "--version" ]; then
    echo "demucs-stem 1.0.0"
    exit 0
fi
INPUT="${1:-}"
OUTPUT="${2:-}"
if [ -z "$INPUT" ] || [ -z "$OUTPUT" ]; then
    echo "Usage: demucs-stem <input_file> <output_zip>" >&2
    exit 1
fi
TMP_DIR="$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/demucs_stem.XXXXXX")"
trap 'rm -rf "$TMP_DIR"' EXIT
"{dir}/env/bin/demucs" -n htdemucs -d mps --mp3 --filename "{stem}.{ext}" -o "$TMP_DIR" "$INPUT"
mkdir -p "$(dirname "$OUTPUT")"
(cd "$TMP_DIR/htdemucs" && /usr/bin/zip -q -9 -j "$OUTPUT" *.mp3)
